questions.question: What is the primary function of a Cylindrical Square?

answers.a: To measure the diameter of a cylinder.
answers.b: To check the squareness of two planes.
answers.c: To scribe circles on a workpiece.
answers.d: To hold round stock for drilling.

explanations.b: Correct. It checks 'out-of-squareness'. Refer to Tutorial 9

questions.question: What is the accuracy of the Vernier scale on a standard Bevel Protractor?

explanations.a: Incorrect. This is plate protractor accuracy.
explanations.c: Correct. The vernier divides each degree into 12 parts. Refer to Tutorial 10

questions.question: Which formula is used to calculate the height (H) for a Sine Bar setting?

explanations.c: Correct. Height equals Length times the Sine of the angle. Refer to Tutorial 10

questions.question: Why is Layout Dye (or wet chalk) applied to a workpiece surface?

answers.c: To make scribed lines highly visible.

explanations.c: Correct. It provides contrast against the shiny metal. Refer to Tutorial 11

questions.question: What are the two main parts of an Engineer's Try Square?

explanations.a: Correct. The thick stock and thin blade. Refer to Tutorial 12

questions.question: Which tool is specifically designed to scribe lines parallel to the edge of a workpiece?

explanations.b: Correct. One leg rests on the edge, the other scribes. Refer to Tutorial 13
explanations.c: Incorrect. Used for measuring outside diameter.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Used for measuring inside diameter.

questions.question: What is the primary advantage of a Granite Surface Plate over a Cast Iron one?

answers.c: It does not burr when chipped and is rust-proof.

explanations.c: Correct. It provides a stable, low-maintenance reference plane. Refer to Tutorial 14

questions.question: What is the included angle of the V-groove in a standard V-Block?

explanations.c: Correct. It is designed to hold cylindrical parts securely. Refer to Tutorial 14

questions.question: At what angle should a scriber be held against the rule while marking?

explanations.b: Correct. Tipped outward slightly in the direction of movement. Refer to Tutorial 15

questions.question: Which punch has a sharp 90-degree conical tip and is used to mark the center of a hole for drilling?

explanations.a: Incorrect. Prick punch has a 30-degree tip.
explanations.c: Correct. The 90-degree tip allows the drill to start properly. Refer to Tutorial 16
